questions.feedback: Hydrogen is a chemical element. It is also the lightest element.

questions.prompt: Why is hydrogen rarely found alone on Earth?

choices.label: It disappears when it reaches Earth
It usually joins with other elements

questions.feedback: Hydrogen easily combines with other elements. For example, hydrogen joins with oxygen to form water.

choices.label: Two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom
Two hydrogen tanks and one oxygen tank
Two oxygen atoms and one hydrogen atom

questions.feedback: H stands for hydrogen, O stands for oxygen, and the small 2 tells us there are two hydrogen atoms.

questions.prompt: What do the colours grey, blue, turquoise and green tell us about hydrogen?

choices.label: The actual colour of the hydrogen gas
Which colour tank the hydrogen prefers

questions.feedback: Hydrogen itself is colourless. The colour names describe the different methods used to produce hydrogen.

questions.prompt: Which type of hydrogen is produced using renewable electricity and water?
questions.feedback: Green hydrogen is produced by using renewable electricity, such as solar or wind power, to split water.

choices.label: Using electricity to split water into hydrogen and oxygen

questions.feedback: Electrolysis uses electrical energy to separate water into hydrogen and oxygen.
